pageProps.seoDescription: Breeder is a Legends of Idleon pet gene. Every 1 sec, heal whatever Mob you are holding down on for 10% HP. On PC, you just need you mouse over the Mob. On Phones, your finger must be on the Mob. This lasts 15 seconds.
